gloss: to gush out; to spurt out; to spout

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {吹|ふ}き{出|で}ていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to gush out; to spurt out; to spout
definitions.explanation: Liquid, gas, or substance erupting outward

definitions.gloss: to break out; to appear on the surface
definitions.explanation: Sweat, pimples, rashes appearing on the skin

examples.japanese: {水|みず}が{地面|じめん}から{吹|ふ}き{出|で}た。
examples.english: Water gushed out from the ground.

examples.japanese: {蒸気|じょうき}がパイプから{吹|ふ}き{出|で}ている。
examples.english: Steam is spouting from the pipe.

examples.japanese: {火山|かざん}から{溶岩|ようがん}が{吹|ふ}き{出|で}た。
examples.english: Lava gushed out from the volcano.

examples.japanese: {額|ひたい}に{汗|あせ}が{吹|ふ}き{出|で}た。
examples.english: Sweat broke out on my forehead.

examples.japanese: {顔|かお}にニキビが{吹|ふ}き{出|で}た。
examples.english: Pimples broke out on my face.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}で{全身|ぜんしん}に{汗|あせ}が{吹|ふ}き{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: Sweat broke out all over my body from nervousness.

notes:
An intransitive compound verb combining {吹|ふ}く (to blow) + {出|で}る (to come out). Describes something emerging forcefully from inside to outside. Used for liquids, gases, and things appearing on the skin.

TRANSITIVITY: intransitive (transitive pair: {吹|ふ}き{出|だ}す)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水|みず}が{吹|ふ}き{出|で}る: water gushes out
- {汗|あせ}が{吹|ふ}き{出|で}る: sweat breaks out
- ニキビが{吹|ふ}き{出|で}る: pimples break out
- {蒸気|じょうき}が{吹|ふ}き{出|で}る: steam spouts out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {吹|ふ}き{出|だ}す: to spout/burst out — the transitive counterpart; also means to burst out laughing
- {噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す: to erupt/spew — emphasizes violent eruption; also means to burst out laughing
- {溢|あふ}れる: to overflow — liquid exceeding its container, without the forceful eruption nuance
